envelope.description: Pure signoff decisions and the request Reference mapping

body.title: Pure signoff decisions and the request Reference mapping
body.summary: Add src/workflow/team/signoff.ts with followedStageOf, isSignedOffOrGrandfathered, signoffViewOf and signoffRecordsOf, and the conversion between a request ref and the lifecycle Reference { entityId, type signoff-request, relation tracked-by }. All pure, over injected policy and heads.
acceptanceChecks: followedStageOf maps author design.epic, design.story, plan and build to the stage they follow and anything else to null
isSignedOffOrGrandfathered counts signed-off heads and grandfathers only when anchorKnown is true
signoffRecordsOf groups completed signoffs by the ref read from entityId
The Reference round trip keeps the ref and never changes the Reference type

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: signoffRecordsOf derives sc5 records from lifecycle facts, groups by the ref read from entityId, and grandfathers by the shared rule

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-hook.test.ts: isSignedOffOrGrandfathered counts a signed-off head, counts a head approved before the anchor only when anchorKnown is true, and never grandfathers when anchorKnown is false

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-hook.test.ts: followedStageOf maps author design.epic to DEF on the epic, author design.story to HLD on the epic, author plan and build to LLD on the story, and anything else to null
